rationale: C10 is the strongest superficial match because both are Eisenhower letters to foreign leaders concerning Geneva, negotiation, peace, and improved international atmosphere. C03 likewise uses a diplomatic letter to explain a security proposal, reassure the recipient of peaceful intentions, and express hope for understanding. C12 shares the salutation to a chairman and the pattern of acknowledging a recent letter before discussing a proposal. These similarities, however, consist of shared subject matter and conventional diplomatic-correspondence structure. None reproduces the child's distinctive sequence of acknowledging detailed questions, postponing a full response pending adviser work, describing reciprocal aerial inspection as a confidence-building measure, connecting it to broader arms inspection and reduction, and conditionally accepting stationary inspection teams. No displayed candidate plausibly supplied a concrete, material drafting template.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I wish to thank you for your [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] about my Geneva proposal
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I was most happy to receive your letter of July twenty-fifth, expressing satisfaction with the results of the recent Geneva Conference.
shared_material.explanation: C10 shares an acknowledgment of a foreign leader's letter about Geneva, but this is conventional diplomatic framing rather than distinctive borrowed drafting.

shared_material.child_excerpt: to show a spirit of non-aggressiveness on both sides and so to create a fresh atmosphere which would dispel much of the present fear and suspicion
shared_material.parent_excerpt: We must now look forward to a period of arduous and continuing negotiation in the effort to achieve the aims of peace and justice for all men in an atmosphere which will permit the growth of freedom.
shared_material.explanation: C10 has a broadly parallel appeal to negotiation and a favorable atmosphere for peace, without the child's particular confidence-building machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hope that we can agree on it
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Now that the facts are known, I hope that the real import of our decision will be understood.
shared_material.explanation: C03 similarly closes diplomatic explanation with hope for acceptance or understanding, but the language and operative substance are not sufficiently specific.
